⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: second identical `getPrComments` fetch — the comment list is read twice per review round**

In `action()`, step 6.5 and the new step 6.6 run back-to-back and each fetches the same PR comment list:

```javascript
writeFindingRegistryContext(ctx, prOutcome.pr.number);   // step 6.5 → scm.getPrComments(pr.number)
writeNewHunksContext(ctx, prDetails);                    // step 6.6 → scm.getPrComments(pr.number) AGAIN
```

`prCommentListForRegistry(ctx.scm, prNumber)` (js/preparePRForReview.js:282-286) wraps `scm.getPrComments(prNumber)` — a provider API round-trip. Every review round now pays it twice: once to parse registry records, once to parse verdict records — from the identical payload. GitHub/ADO API budget is finite and this leg runs on every lap of the review↔rework machine; it is also a second failure surface for the exact same call.

Fetch once and thread it through:

```javascript
var comments = prCommentListForRegistry(ctx.scm, prOutcome.pr.number);
writeFindingRegistryContext(ctx, prOutcome.pr.number, comments);
writeNewHunksContext(ctx, prDetails, comments);
```

Both steps already tolerate `comments === null` (skip quietly), so the contract is preserved unchanged. This also reduces `writeNewHunksContext`'s cyclomatic complexity toward the CRAP threshold — it helps fix the blocking ratchet finding at the same time.

💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: `sameHead` hand-copies the prefix-equality rule from `reviewVerdicts.latestVerdictForHead`**

The doc comment says "same rule as latestVerdictForHead" — and it is a byte-for-byte re-implementation of js/common/reviewVerdicts.js:380-382:

```javascript
if (records[i].head === head ||
    (head.length >= 7 && records[i].head.indexOf(head) === 0) ||
    (records[i].head.length >= 7 && head.indexOf(records[i].head) === 0)) {
```

Two live copies of a subtle matching rule (`>=7`-char prefix) can drift: if one side later changes the minimum prefix length, the diff-of-diff trigger in `preparePRForReview` ("heads differ → new hunks file") and the SM's verdict-for-head matching would disagree — e.g. a verdict recorded as "reviewed at this head" that the other component treats as a different head. This repo has already paid exactly this cost once: `dirScopedCmd` was extracted in gh-1248 because "three byte-identical copies grew here".

Suggested shape: export the matcher from `reviewVerdicts.js` (where the rule is documented and already characterized by tests) and call it from both places:

```javascript
// reviewVerdicts.js
function sameHead(a, b) { /* the existing prefix rule */ }
module.exports = { ..., sameHead: sameHead };
```

🪶 severity: NIT —
🪶 **NIT: dead import — `machineAuthor` is required but never used**

`js/common/prNewHunks.js:21` pulls in `machineAuthor`:

```javascript
var machineAuthor = require('./machineAuthor.js');
```

but nothing in the module references it — the allowlist filtering happens entirely inside `reviewVerdicts.parseVerdictRecords(comments, opts)`, which receives `opts` from the caller. The `require` map in the tests (`test_prNewHunks.js` `prNewHunksDeps`) faithfully injects it, which shows the dead wiring is real, not an oversight in tests.

Drop the import (and the corresponding `makeRequire` entries) or, if the intent was to validate `opts.authorLogins` here, do that — but as written it is unused code. The module header's "opts carries the machineAuthor allowlist" comment is fine once the import goes.

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The `crap` CI gate fails on head `9ddc6b33` — this PR adds two functions over the CRAP threshold (`writeNewHunksContext` 11, `prGitOpsMocks` 10; ratchet: "CRAP may only decrease", exit 2) — CI breakage blocks merge. Also: a comment-derived `head` sha is interpolated into a git command unvalidated, and the PR comment list is fetched twice per round. The gh-1404 design itself matches the ticket; all 105 new/updated unit tests pass locally.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 `js/preparePRForReview.js:325` — refactor `writeNewHunksContext` (CRAP 11) + `prGitOpsMocks` below threshold 8 (ci_failures_full.log:43871-43874)
- ⚠️ `js/common/gitOps.js:363` — validate `fromSha`/`toSha` (`/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/`) before command interpolation (value read from PR comment content, not config)
- ⚠️ `js/preparePRForReview.js:329` — step 6.6 re-fetches the same `getPrComments` payload step 6.5 just fetched; fetch once, pass through
- 💡 `js/common/prNewHunks.js:41` — `sameHead` duplicates `reviewVerdicts.latestVerdictForHead`'s prefix rule (reviewVerdicts.js:380-382); share one matcher
- 🪶 `js/common/prNewHunks.js:21` — dead `machineAuthor` import

**Digest**: `js/preparePRForReview.js:282` — registry-specific name now serves the verdict-head step · `js/common/prNewHunks.js:27` — header's machineAuthor claim doesn't match the module body.

**Next Steps**:
1. Refactor the two over-threshold functions until `crap` is green (helper extraction resolves the duplicate fetch too)
2. Add sha-format validation; export the shared `sameHead` matcher from `reviewVerdicts.js`
3. Drop the dead import; re-run the three PR verify suites
